title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation is a technique used to assess how the results of a statistical analysis will generalize to an independent data set. It is mainly used for model validation and selection.

title: Purpose of Cross-Validation
text: Think about the main goals of cross-validation. It helps in estimating the skill of a model on new data, tuning hyperparameters, and selecting models. It is not typically used for solving issues related to the design matrix.

hintAnswer: Find an optimal solution when the design matrix is not full column rank.
title: Identifying the Odd One Out
text: Which of the following is NOT a typical use case for cross-validation?
choices: Determining how well a model generalizes.
Selecting the degree of polynomial models.
Find an optimal solution when the design matrix is not full column rank.
